syscalls.comment: Absolute minimum syscalls for static binaries (scratch images). Covers: file I/O (read/write/close), memory management (mmap/mprotect/munmap), signals, threading (futex), and process lifecycle (exit). No networking, no process creation beyond exit.
Time-related syscalls needed by most applications for logging, timeouts, and scheduling.
Heap management. brk for initial heap allocation, madvise for memory hints.
x86_64 architecture setup needed for Go runtime initialization.
getrandom for cryptographic randomness, rseq for restartable sequences (Go runtime).
